import java.util.*;
import java.io.*;

public class Main {
    static final int MOD1 = 998244353;
    static final int MOD2 = 1000000007;
    static final int MAXN = 2000000;
    static final int MAX = 1000000;
    static long n_value, c_value;
    static int total, ans, lim;
    static int[] pw = new int[9];
    static int[] sum = new int[7];
    static List<Integer>[] v = new ArrayList[7];

    static {
        for (int i = 0; i < 7; i++) {
            v[i] = new ArrayList<>();
        }
    }

    static int dec(int x, int y, int m) {
        return (x - y < 0) ? x - y + m : x - y;
    }

    static int add(int x, int y, int m) {
        return (x + y >= m) ? x + y - m : x + y;
    }

    static void dfs(int pos, long now) {
        if (now <= n_value) {
            total++;
            int x = dec(total, (int) now, MOD1);
            v[pos - 1].add(x);
            sum[pos - 1] = add(sum[pos - 1], x, MOD2);
        }
        if (pos > 6) return;
        for (int i = 0; i <= 9; i++) {
            dfs(pos + 1, now * 10 + i);
        }
    }

    static void solve(int pos, long now) {
        if (now > n_value) return;
        if (pos > 1) {
            if (10L * now * MAX > n_value && 1L * (now + 1) * MAX - 1 <= n_value) {
                for (int i = 0; i < 7; i++) {
                    int x = ((int) ((c_value - 1L * now * pw[i]) % MOD1 + MOD1) % MOD1);
                    int p = lowerBound(v[i], MOD1 - x);
                    ans = add(ans, add((int) ((1L * x * v[i].size()) % MOD2 + sum[i]) % MOD2, MOD2), MOD2);
                    ans = dec(ans, (int) ((1L * MOD1 * (v[i].size() - p)) % MOD2), MOD2);
                }
                c_value += total;
                return;
            }
            c_value++;
            ans = add(ans, (int) (((c_value - now) % MOD1 + MOD1) % MOD1), MOD2);
        }
        int start = (pos == 1) ? 1 : 0;
        for (int i = start; i <= 9; i++) {
            solve(pos + 1, now * 10 + i);
        }
    }

    static int lowerBound(List<Integer> list, int target) {
        int low = 0, high = list.size();
        while (low < high) {
            int mid = (low + high) / 2;
            if (list.get(mid) >= target) {
                high = mid;
            } else {
                low = mid + 1;
            }
        }
        return low;
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {
        BufferedReader br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
        n_value = Long.parseLong(br.readLine());
        for (int i = 1; i < 9; i++) {
            pw[i] = 10 * pw[i - 1];
        }
        dfs(1, 0);
        for (int i = 0; i < 7; i++) {
            Collections.sort(v[i]);
        }
        solve(1, 0);
        System.out.println(ans);
    }
}
